title: FFmpeg image2 warns on one-file waveform render without explicit single-image update mode
symptom: The first successful render emitted an image-sequence-pattern warning even though the requested PNG was written.
expected_behavior: A one-shot waveform render should succeed without an ambiguous sequence warning.
actual_behavior: Render succeeded but stderr suggested using a sequence pattern or -update.
proposed_fix: Pass -update 1 with -frames:v 1 when using image2 for a single fixed PNG path.
verification: Second render exited zero and the image-sequence-pattern warning disappeared; output digest remained c853c96a1a0f9f092935882fb6a912e9d196a3ddf9e3390cc1d3453d0a37f3ac.
